_README: plan/2 B13 (minimal cut). The Scenarios page's templates, as DATA: each is a named set of shocks in the vocabulary of packs/forecast/levers.yaml#registry (driver_key, op, value), POSTed to /api/forecast/{period_id}/recompute exactly as declared. Values are exact decimal strings in the driver's own unit (a level_pct is a decimal fraction, a days change is days). A driver_key ending in '.*' expands over the served driver keys with that prefix (pool_level.* = every operating-cost pool the book serves, read from the served response). No template text lives here (the names and questions are page chrome in frontend/i18n/locales, namespace scenarios). Read by frontend/lib/scenarioTemplates.ts and by tests/engine/test_scenario_page_templates.py, which runs every set through the engine on the four corpus books. Moves to packs/scenarios/templates.yaml when B10 serves templates.
